title: NULL pointer dereference after unchecked allocation
guidance: Devign labels functions that dereference a pointer without checking the result of allocation. Always verify malloc/calloc did not return NULL before use: `buf = malloc(len); if (!buf) return -ENOMEM; memcpy(buf, src, len);`

title: Use-after-free of a freed resource
guidance: Devign flags paths that read memory after free(). Null the pointer immediately after freeing and never dereference it: `free(node); node = NULL;`. Read values into locals before freeing.

title: Integer overflow in size computation (CVE-class)
guidance: Big-Vul (MSR'20) contains many CVEs where an arithmetic overflow produces a too-small allocation. Use overflow-checked arithmetic (e.g. __builtin_mul_overflow) or reject large inputs before multiplying: `if (count && size > SIZE_MAX / count) return -EOVERFLOW;`

title: Out-of-bounds read past buffer end
guidance: Big-Vul labels out-of-bounds reads driven by attacker-controlled indices. Bounds-check every index against the real buffer length before access: `if (index >= header_len) return -EINVAL; return header[index];`

title: Uncontrolled format string
guidance: The NIST Juliet suite covers format-string weaknesses. Never pass untrusted data as the format argument; use a fixed format specifier: `printf("%s", user_input);`

title: Integer overflow leading to incorrect allocation
vulnerable:
int size = a + b;
byte[] buf = new byte[size];
guidance: Juliet includes CWE-190 test cases in Java. Validate operands and use Math.addExact to throw on overflow: `int size = Math.addExact(a, b);` and reject negative/oversized sizes before allocation.

title: Out-of-bounds write via unchecked copy length
guidance: DiverseVul contains large-scale real-world OOB-write samples. Use bounded copies sized to the destination: `strncpy(dst, src, sizeof(dst) - 1); dst[sizeof(dst)-1] = '\0';` or snprintf.

title: SQL injection via string interpolation
guidance: DiverseVul includes injection samples across languages. Use parameterized queries so untrusted input is never part of the SQL text: `cur.execute("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?", (uid,))`.

title: Single-statement bug: missing null check before method call
guidance: ManySStuBs4J catalogues real single-statement Java bugs; missing null checks are common. Guard before dereferencing: `String v = config.getValue(); return v == null ? "" : v.trim();` or use Optional.

title: XML External Entity (XXE) via unhardened parser
guidance: SAP Project-KB tracks fixed Java library vulnerabilities including XXE. Disable external entities and DTDs on the parser: `dbf.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);` before building.
